body: On the back: “the first morning, a medicinal odor in the cab after the experimental seed run. my throat tightened. Later, county trucks reached us.”
title: Cab note — the first morning
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a medicinal odor while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: Tire chalk
body: A worker drew a chalk circle around the stopped car and promised a tow after the next convoy. The convoy arrived, took everyone able to walk, and crossed our names off his pad. I stayed to finish the tire and found the pad discarded.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
